notes: Components analyzed via grep scan for window/document/navigator/localStorage usage patterns. Categories reflect Next.js 15 App Router usage (not @lit-labs/ssr streaming SSR). All Lit web components are safe as inert HTML tags in RSC — the import boundary is the critical constraint.

knownIssues: hx-format-date calls document.documentElement.lang and navigator.language inside render() — would crash with @lit-labs/ssr streaming render
hx-breadcrumb injects JSON-LD <script> tags into document.head via connectedCallback — incompatible with streaming SSR
hx-theme uses window.matchMedia but has typeof window === 'undefined' guard — SSR-safe

ssr_safe.description: Purely presentational or layout components. Element tags can be rendered in React Server Components. No window/document/navigator APIs in render() or constructor(). Safe to include in RSC output as static HTML — browser upgrades happen after hydration.
ssr_safe.strategy: Render in RSC directly. Import component JS in a 'use client' HelixLoader.

needs_client_boundary.description: Components that use window/document/navigator APIs only in connectedCallback, disconnectedCallback, firstUpdated, or event handlers — not in render() or constructor(). Safe as static HTML in RSC. Must be wrapped in 'use client' components when interactivity is needed.
needs_client_boundary.strategy: Render tag in RSC for initial HTML. Wrap in 'use client' Client Component for event handling. Use 'use client' + dynamic import in a HelixLoader for registration.

client_only.description: Components that MUST use next/dynamic with ssr: false due to browser-only APIs called at module evaluation or that cannot degrade gracefully without a browser context.
client_only.strategy: Use next/dynamic(() => import('...'), { ssr: false }) or ensure 'use client' with dynamic import inside useEffect.

components.name: hx-copy-button
components.notes: navigator.clipboard is only available in secure browser contexts. Falls back gracefully but the component's primary function is unavailable outside the browser.

nextjs_15_app_router.recommendedPattern: HelixLoader in root layout with useEffect dynamic import
nextjs_15_app_router.ssrStrategy: All components render as inert HTML tags in RSC. Custom element upgrade happens client-side after HelixLoader fires.
knownIssues: customElements is not defined in Node.js — never import @helixui/library at module scope in Server Components
Custom events (hx-click, hx-change) not forwarded by React synthetic event system — use ref + addEventListener or @lit/react wrappers
Boolean attributes: disabled={false} must use boolean prop, not string 'false'
nextjs_15_app_router.tripPlannerGuidance: Trip-planner team using Next.js 15 App Router: use the HelixLoader pattern in app/layout.tsx. All hx-* tags in RSC are safe as static HTML. Wrap interactive event handlers in 'use client' components.

astro_5.recommendedPattern: client:load or client:visible directive on interactive islands
astro_5.ssrStrategy: Astro renders component tags as HTML on server. Use client:load for components needing immediate interactivity, client:visible for below-fold components.
knownIssues: Import @helixui/library only in .astro files with client: directives or in script tags
Use <script> tag imports rather than frontmatter imports for web component registration

nuxt_4.recommendedPattern: ClientOnly wrapper component or <client-only> for interactive components
nuxt_4.ssrStrategy: Use Nuxt plugins for global registration. Mark individual islands with <client-only> wrapper.
knownIssues: Register components in a client-only plugin: defineNuxtPlugin with process.client guard
Use <client-only> wrapper for components accessing document/window

litLabsSsr.notes: @lit-labs/ssr streaming SSR was NOT tested in this audit. Components marked 'ssr_safe' are categorized based on absence of browser APIs in render()/constructor() only. hx-format-date would likely crash with @lit-labs/ssr due to document.documentElement.lang access in render(). Full @lit-labs/ssr compatibility testing is a separate effort.
blockers: hx-format-date: document.documentElement.lang in render() — MUST use explicit lang prop
hx-breadcrumb: document.head.appendChild in updated() — requires DOM SSR compatibility

recommendations.title: Add explicit lang prop to hx-format-date
recommendations.description: hx-format-date calls document.documentElement.lang in render(). In the browser this works, but it bypasses the prop API. Always pass lang explicitly to avoid relying on document at render time.
recommendations.action: Add <hx-format-date lang="en-US" date={...}> in all usages

recommendations.title: Document hx-breadcrumb JSON-LD injection as client-only
recommendations.description: hx-breadcrumb injects a JSON-LD <script> into document.head for SEO. This cannot work in SSR streaming because document.head is not writable during streaming. Teams using breadcrumb for SEO structured data must ensure client-side rendering.
recommendations.action: Add warning to hx-breadcrumb docs: JSON-LD injection is client-side only

recommendations.title: Create a HelixLoader component for all frameworks
recommendations.description: A single-file HelixLoader pattern exists for Next.js. Create equivalent for Astro (plugin) and Nuxt (client plugin). This gives a consistent integration point.
recommendations.action: Create framework-specific loader examples in docs/framework-integration/

recommendations.title: Add SSR status badge to component docs
recommendations.description: Each component page should show its SSR compatibility category (SSR Safe / Needs use client / Client Only) so developers know at a glance what wrapper they need.
recommendations.action: Add ssrStatus field to CEM and render in Storybook autodocs

recommendations.title: Evaluate @lit-labs/ssr compatibility
recommendations.description: If trip-planner or other consumers need streaming SSR with Declarative Shadow DOM, a full @lit-labs/ssr compatibility pass is required. hx-format-date and hx-breadcrumb are the known blockers.
recommendations.action: File separate audit feature for @lit-labs/ssr streaming compatibility
